model_response:
**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647, IB4 + Alexa Fluor 488, TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous-based clearing method established for hard tissues like teeth, offering excellent morphology preservation with minimal shrinkage—critical for maintaining intact pulp chamber architecture and preventing the deformation observed with BoneClear. It supports deep antibody and dye penetration into dense mineralized tissue while preserving endogenous fluorescence compatibility (though not required here). PGP9.5 is a well-validated pan-neuronal marker for dental pulp nerves; IB4 labels non-peptidergic sensory nerve fibers and microvasculature in pulp, providing complementary neural and structural context. TO-PRO-3 serves as a far-red nuclear counterstain compatible with Ce3D and avoids spectral overlap with Alexa Fluor 488/647, enabling clear delineation of soft tissue contours without relying on DAPI/Hoechst (which are cautioned against with PGP9.5). This combination ensures specific neural labeling, soft tissue reference, and minimal morphological distortion.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling and Nuclear Counterstaining  
1.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum in PBS) to reduce non-specific binding.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-PGP9.5 (1:200) and biotinylated IB4 (10 µg/mL) in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 1% normal donkey serum in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.3 Washing with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) with gentle agitation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total, with 3 buffer changes every 2 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary reagents: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:300) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated streptavidin (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.5 Washing with PBST with gentle agitation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total, with 3 buffer changes every 2 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with TO-PRO-3 (1 µM in PBS) for nuclear counterstaining.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Tissue Optical Clearing with Ce3D  
2.1 Incubation with Ce3D-A1 solution (25% (wt/vol) fructose, 25% (wt/vol) sucrose, 10% (wt/vol) urea, 0.1 M sodium citrate, pH 6.0).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with Ce3D-A2 solution (50% (wt/vol) fructose, 25% (wt/vol) sucrose, 10% (wt/vol) urea, 0.1 M sodium citrate, pH 6.0).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with Ce3D-B solution (50% (wt/vol) iodixanol, 25% (wt/vol) fructose, 10% (wt/vol) urea, 0.1 M sodium citrate, pH 6.0).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Refractive Index Matching and Mounting  
3.1 Equilibration in Ce3D-RI matching solution (88% (wt/vol) iodixanol in 0.1 M sodium citrate, pH 6.0) until tissue becomes transparent and RI-matched.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Transfer sample into imaging chamber filled with Ce3D-RI matching solution for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at 4 ℃ for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647, GFAP+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for strong delipidation and high refractive index matching in dense tissues like adult mouse brain with embedded glioblastoma, enabling deep penetration and excellent preservation of vascular and tumor architecture. It preserves exogenous fluorophores such as Alexa Fluor dyes while quenching endogenous fluorescent proteins—thus requiring antibody- or dye-based labeling. Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* or *Griffonia simplicifolia* isolectin B4) specifically labels endothelial glycocalyx of functional vasculature (including tumor-associated vessels), and GFAP robustly marks reactive astrocytes that delineate the glioblastoma invasive front and tumor core. Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red) and Alexa Fluor 488 (green) are both highly compatible with FDISCO, providing spectrally separable, photostable signals ideal for 3D imaging of tumor–vasculature spatial relationships.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if tissue has pigmentation)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody and Lectin Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-GFAP primary antibody (1:500 in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% NGS) and biotinylated or directly conjugated Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* lectin, 10 µg/mL) in same buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three more times, total 4 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining (if Lectin not pre-conjugated)  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated streptavidin (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% NGS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 three more times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with benzyl alcohol : benzyl benzoate (BABB, 1:2 vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh BABB (1:2).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with BABB (1:2) and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD8 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires deep, specific labeling of total T cells (via CD3) and cytotoxic T cell subpopulation (via CD8) in a dense, ~8 mm³ fixed mouse tumor—demanding high antibody penetration and strong delipidation. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for this tissue tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering rapid, high-clearing power with excellent compatibility for Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 conjugates. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are not used; instead, robust immunostaining with validated anti-CD3/CD8 antibodies ensures target-specific identification without reliance on non-specific nuclear dyes. iDISCO+’s methanol/dichloromethane-based dehydration and delipidation effectively clear lipid-rich tumor stroma while preserving 3D architecture for spatial quantification of T cell infiltration zones.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for pigmented tumors; include if sample shows visible melanin/hemoglobin)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunostaining)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with rat anti-CD3ε (clone 17A2, 1:200) and rat anti-CD8α (clone 53-6.7, 1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% donkey serum + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBT + 5% donkey serum + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-c-Fos primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody, anti-NeuN primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires mapping behaviorally activated neurons at single-cell resolution across the entire adult mouse brain. Immediate early gene c-Fos is a well-established, target-specific marker for neuronal activation, while NeuN provides pan-neuronal context to distinguish activated neurons within the total neuronal population. iDISCO+ is an organic solvent–based clearing method proven effective for whole adult mouse brains (10–12 mm scale), offering strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, it preserves synthetic fluorophores like Alexa Fluor 488 and 647—ideal for immunolabeling. Its relatively fast processing time (~1–2 weeks) and high refractive index matching enable high-resolution light-sheet imaging with minimal background.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching and Lipid Peroxidation  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with blocking buffer containing anti-c-Fos (rabbit monoclonal, 1:500) and anti-NeuN (mouse monoclonal, 1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes over 24 hours).  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with blocking buffer containing Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated donkey anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated donkey anti-mouse IgG (1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-Labeling Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes over 24 hours).  

9 Dehydration (Post-Immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer brain to glass vial filled with fresh DBE and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite, protected from light)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Osx (Osterix)+Alexa Fluor 488, Osteocalcin+Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** The sample is a dense mineralized hard tissue (P7 mouse cranial suture with adjacent bone plates), requiring a high-clearing-power method that enables deep antibody penetration while preserving 3D architecture. FDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing protocol for bone and hard tissues (T07 tier), offering strong delipidation and refractive index matching suitable for light-sheet or confocal imaging of mm-scale samples. Although FDISCO quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, it is fully compatible with Alexa Fluor–conjugated antibodies and nuclear counterstains like DAPI. We selected Osx (Osterix) as a marker for early/pre-osteoblasts and Osteocalcin for mature osteoblasts/osteocytes—two stage-specific markers essential for resolving spatial organization across the suture-to-bone transition zone. Both are validated targets in postnatal calvarial bone development and compatible with FDISCO-compatible fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488/568). DAPI provides nuclear context without interfering with osteolineage signal.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for bone autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Osx (1:200) and anti-Osteocalcin (1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (1% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.02% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, gentle shaking)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, total washing time: 6 hours  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500), plus DAPI (1 µg/mL), all diluted in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 four times, total washing time: 5 hours  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation and Clearing  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate (BABB, 1:2 vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh BABB (1:2 vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with BABB (1:2 vol/vol) and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 488, MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The problem involves 3 mm thick, densely fixed human cortical tissue where deep antibody penetration failed with aqueous PBS-based labeling. uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for dense human clinical brain blocks (T09_HUMAN_DENSE_CLINICAL_BLOCK), offering strong delipidation and high refractive index matching that enables deep antibody penetration and uniform labeling throughout millimeter-scale thicknesses. It is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 conjugates—robust synthetic fluorophores resistant to organic solvents—and supports dual-pan-neuronal structural labeling: NeuN (nuclear marker of mature neurons) and MAP2 (dendritic/somatic marker), providing complementary spatial confirmation of mature neuron identity and improving reliability of deep-cell detection. Endogenous fluorescence is not required (no GFP/YFP transgenes in human tissue), so FP quenching by uDISCO is irrelevant. The protocol integrates extended permeabilization, methanol-based dehydration, and detergent-enhanced antibody incubation to overcome the original penetration failure.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for antibody labeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-NeuN (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) and anti-MAP2 (rabbit polyclonal, 1:500) diluted in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 two more times (total 3 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-labeling Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 two more times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

12 Storage and Imaging  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in a sealed glass vial protected from light at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with 488 nm and 640 nm laser lines for dual-channel mature neuron detection across full 3 mm depth.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (from *Lycopersicon esculentum*) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 for functional perfused vasculature; anti-CD31 (PECAM1) primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody for endothelial structural morphology]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like placenta (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH tier), offering strong delipidation, deep dye/antibody penetration, and excellent preservation of exogenous fluorophores including Alexa Fluor dyes and lectins. It maintains high signal-to-noise for both vascular lumen labeling (via intravascular lectin perfusion) and immunostained endothelial markers. Lectin-AF647 binds specifically to glycocalyx on perfused vessel lumens, directly reporting functional perfusion, while CD31 immunostaining reveals total endothelial architecture—including non-perfused or collapsed vessels—enabling spatial comparison of structure vs. function across placental subregions (labyrinth, trophoblast zones, margins). FDISCO’s compatibility with both AF488 and AF647 ensures dual-channel integrity without quenching.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Based Functional Vessel Labeling (performed *before* fixation if possible; if post-fixation, proceed with passive incubation)  
1.1 Incubation with 50 µg/mL *Lycopersicon esculentum* Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 in PBS containing 1 mM CaCl₂ and 1 mM MnCl₂ to support lectin binding.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Immunostaining for Endothelial Structure  
2.1 Permeabilization with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.2 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM1) primary antibody diluted 1:200 in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.4 Washing with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes, 6 hours each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 18 hours total)  
2.5 Incubation with goat anti-rat IgG secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488, diluted 1:400 in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.6 Final washes with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes, 6 hours each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 18 hours total)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Delipidation and Bleaching  
4.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide in 100% methanol (prepared fresh from 30% H₂O₂ stock).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Rehydration (reverse methanol series)  
5.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Organic Solvent Transition  
6.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma-Aldrich 112372) without shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.2 Transfer to fresh 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hoechst 33342, Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 647, anti-Ki67–Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a rapid, high-clearing-power solvent-based method compatible with exogenous fluorescent dyes and antibodies, ideal for dense 1–3 mm human brain organoids. It preserves Alexa Fluor and Hoechst signals better than iDISCO+ and avoids the slow kinetics of aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, ScaleS), enabling high-throughput processing. The labeling strategy combines: (1) Hoechst for total nuclear density and organoid volume segmentation; (2) Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 647 to delineate F-actin–rich cortical/epithelial-like boundaries and overall 3D morphology; and (3) anti-Ki67–Alexa Fluor 568 as a specific proliferation marker to assess drug-induced growth arrest. All fluorophores are explicitly compatible with FDISCO per the knowledge base, and the protocol integrates immunolabeling before delipidation to ensure deep penetration.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Permeabilization and Blocking  
1.1 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Primary Antibody Staining  
2.1 Incubation with rabbit anti-Ki67 primary antibody diluted 1:200 in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

3 Secondary Antibody and Counterstain Labeling  
3.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:100), and Hoechst 33342 (10 µg/mL) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

4 Dehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Delipidation and Bleaching  
5.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh: 1 vol 30% H₂O₂ + 5 vol MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Rehydration (for optional post-clearing validation; skip if proceeding directly to clearing)  
6.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (fresh).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Transfer samples to glass vials filled with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)  
8.2 Mount cleared organoids in ECi-filled imaging chambers compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy immediately before acquisition.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires tracing two distinct somatosensory pathways through large, lipid-rich CNS tissues (3 cm spinal cord, thalamus, and cortex). Lipophilic carbocyanine dyes DiI (red-emitting) and DiD (far-red-emitting) are ideal for long-range axonal tracing, integrate stably into membranes without requiring genetic manipulation or immunostaining, and are compatible with solvent-based clearing. uDISCO is selected because it provides high clearing power for dense, long CNS specimens (>15 mm), efficiently removes lipids to render tissue transparent while preserving DiI/DiD fluorescence, enables deep penetration, and achieves high refractive index matching suitable for light-sheet imaging. uDISCO is established for whole-body and long-projection studies and is explicitly compatible with DiI/DiD labeling.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation and Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ added to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (optional pre-stain rinse; skip if dyes already applied pre-fixation)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Dye Application (if not pre-applied; otherwise skip to Step 5)  
4.1 Incubation with 10 µM DiI in PBS (or directly injected at peripheral nerve entry sites prior to fixation; if post-fixation labeling, apply via crystal placement on cut spinal cord ends or immersion).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
4.2 Incubation with 10 µM DiD in PBS (applied to second pathway analogously).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
4.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, with gentle agitation)  

5 Dehydration (post-labeling)

5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

6 Dichloromethane (DCM) Treatment  
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, stored over molecular sieves).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) without shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for final clearing and storage.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-HCN4 + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 568, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for whole mouse organs (15–20 mm), offering high clearing power for dense, lipid-rich tissues like the heart while preserving exogenous fluorophores such as Alexa Fluor dyes. It enables deep antibody penetration and achieves high refractive index matching suitable for light-sheet imaging. HCN4 is a well-established specific marker for sinoatrial and atrioventricular nodal pacemaker cells; Cntn2 (Contactin-2) robustly labels Purkinje fibers in the ventricular conduction system. Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 provides high-fidelity F-actin labeling to reveal cardiomyocyte orientation as structural context without interfering with target-specific signals. All chosen fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488/568/647) are fully compatible with FDISCO per compatibility data.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (post-PFA fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with PBS only.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (6% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-HCN4 (1:200) and anti-Cntn2 (1:200) in antibody dilution buffer (3% donkey serum, 0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

4 Washing  
4.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.3 Final wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Staining  
5.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit IgG-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400) and donkey anti-mouse IgG-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:400), plus Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200), in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, protected from light)  

6 Post-Staining Washes  
6.1 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Dehydration  
7.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.4 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Delipidation  
8.1 Incubation with 1:2 mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma 112372-500ML).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with fresh ethyl cinnamate.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
10.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with ethyl cinnamate for long-term storage at RT, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
10.2 Mount in custom chamber filled with ethyl cinnamate for light-sheet or confocal imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (functional perfused vasculature) + CD31/PECAM1 + Alexa Fluor 647 (total endothelial network)]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-refractive-index clearing method established for dense adult mouse brain tissue (5–12 mm scale), offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody/dye penetration, and excellent preservation of exogenous fluorophores—including Alexa Fluor dyes and lectin conjugates—while enabling long-term sample stability. It is compatible with both Lectin (to label only perfused, lumen-accessible vessels via intracardiac or local perfusion) and immunostaining for CD31 to reveal the complete vascular endothelial architecture. This dual-labeling strategy directly addresses the scientific goal: Lectin defines functional,灌流-competent vasculature (highlighting灌流缺失区 and vessel occlusion), while CD31 reveals total vessel density, fragmentation, and abnormal morphology in tumor core vs. invasive margin. FDISCO’s rapid processing (~days) and compatibility with light-sheet/confocal imaging make it ideal for 3D vascular mapping in glioma microenvironments.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Based Lectin Labeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Intracardiac perfusion with 10 mL ice-cold PBS followed by 10 mL of 100 μg/mL DyLight 594-conjugated *Lycopersicon esculentum* Lectin (Vector Labs, DL-1177) in PBS.(Temperature: RT during perfusion, Time: ~5 minutes total perfusion)  
1.2 Post-fixation in 4% PFA/PBS for 2 hours.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Immunostaining for CD31  
2.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 5% normal goat serum in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody: rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM1, BioLegend, clone 390) diluted 1:200 in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 1% BSA, 0.02% NaN₃ in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days with gentle shaking)  
2.3 Washing with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS), 3 changes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: goat anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher, A-21247) diluted 1:300 in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days with gentle shaking)  
2.5 Washing with PBST, 3 changes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation and Bleaching  
4.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Rehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

6 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with FDISCO-D1 (dichloromethane : methanol = 1:1, vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with FDISCO-D2 (100% dichloromethane).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with FDISCO-C (ethyl cinnamate, ECi, Sigma 112372).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.4 Incubation with fresh FDISCO-C (ethyl cinnamate).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

7 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Store sample immersed in FDISCO-C at RT in sealed glass vial protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite until imaging)  
7.2 Mount sample in FDISCO-C-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [alpha-bungarotoxin–Alexa Fluor 647, anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)–Alexa Fluor 568, Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft tissues (e.g., skeletal muscle) in the 5–20 mm size range, offering strong delipidation and deep probe penetration required for intact NMJ imaging. It efficiently clears myelin and lipid-rich structures while preserving antigenicity for antibody labeling when performed post-fixation. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy relies entirely on exogenous dyes/antibodies compatible with iDISCO+: Alexa Fluor 647 (for alpha-bungarotoxin binding to AChR clusters), Alexa Fluor 568 (conjugated to anti–β-III Tubulin/TUJ1 to label motor axons/neurites), and Alexa Fluor 488–Phalloidin (to visualize F-actin in myofibers as structural reference). All three fluorophores are explicitly listed as compatible with iDISCO+. This combination enables high-resolution 3D mapping of NMJ postsynaptic sites, presynaptic motor terminals, and surrounding myofiber architecture without reliance on transgenic reporters.

**Protocol Steps:**

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, with gentle agitation)

6.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.4 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, IB4+Alexa Fluor 647, TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (T05 tier) with strong delipidation power, enabling deep antibody and dye penetration into 3–4 mm kidney tissue while preserving fine glomerular architecture. It maintains compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes and TO-PRO-3, critical for robust dual labeling of slit diaphragm proteins Nephrin and Podocin—key structural markers of the filtration barrier—and allows concurrent vascular labeling via IB4 (a lectin that binds endothelial glycocalyx) and nuclear counterstaining with TO-PRO-3. Unlike iDISCO+, FDISCO preserves fluorescence intensity better across multiple channels and minimizes signal quenching, which is essential for quantitative assessment of barrier integrity in thick samples.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Primary Antibody Staining  
2.1 Rehydration: stepwise rehydration through 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (15 min each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes per step)  
2.2 Permeabilization and blocking: incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) and anti-Podocin (NPHS2) diluted 1:200 in antibody dilution buffer (1% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.4 Wash: 3 × 1 hour washes with PBST (0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

3 Secondary Antibody & Lectin/Nuclear Staining  
3.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-goat IgG (1:500), plus Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated IB4 (10 µg/mL), all in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Nuclear counterstain: addition of TO-PRO-3 (1:1000) to the same solution during secondary incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.3 Wash: 3 × 2 hours washes with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

4 Dehydration (post-staining)  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Delipidation  
5.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Repeat 100% DCM incubation with fresh solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Transfer sample to glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with fresh ECi.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage up to 1 week at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Brn3a/POU4F1 + Alexa Fluor 488, Brn3b/POU4F2 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The problem requires dual immunolabeling of two Brn3/POU4F family transcription factors (Brn3a/POU4F1 and Brn3b/POU4F2), which are well-established nuclear identity markers for retinal ganglion cells. Since the tissue is a fixed adult mouse eye with high pigment content and strong autofluorescence, a high-clearing-power method is essential. iDISCO+ provides excellent delipidation and pigment removal in dense, pigmented ocular tissue, enables deep antibody penetration, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes (which resist organic solvent quenching). Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous primary/secondary antibodies conjugated to stable synthetic fluorophores. Among established methods for whole-eye clearing, iDISCO+ offers faster processing and superior background suppression compared to aqueous alternatives, critical for reducing spontaneous background from melanin.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488, MBP + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is an established high-clearing-power solvent-based method optimized for long-range neural tracing in dense, lipid-rich CNS tissues like spinal cord segments up to several centimeters. It enables deep antibody penetration and excellent refractive index matching for light-sheet imaging, critical for resolving regenerating vs. mature axonal tracts across the injury epicenter. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in uDISCO, so robust immunolabeling with photostable Alexa Fluor dyes is required. β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all neuronal processes—including regenerating fibers—while myelin basic protein (MBP) specifically marks mature, myelinated axons, enabling spatial discrimination between newly extending neurites and preserved/established tracts. Both primary antibodies are compatible with uDISCO’s organic solvent workflow, and Alexa Fluor 488/647 are highly stable under uDISCO conditions.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, e.g., BioLegend 801201, 1:500) and anti-MBP (e.g., Abcam ab7349, 1:250) diluted in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 four more times (total 5 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500) diluted in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-labeling Washing  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 four more times (total 5 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The problem requires whole-brain mapping of two distinct immediate early gene (IEG)-expressing activated neuron subpopulations in an adult mouse brain (~10 mm scale), demanding deep antibody penetration, strong lipid removal, and minimal signal loss. iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for whole adult mouse brains, offering high clearing power, rapid processing, and excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so target-specific immunolabeling with Alexa Fluor 488 and 568—both compatible with iDISCO+—is optimal. C-Fos and Npas4 are canonical IEG markers that specifically label behaviorally activated neuronal ensembles, fulfilling the requirement to distinguish two activation states.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Storage  
1.1 Post-fixation in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Wash in PBS three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
1.3 Store in PBS with 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide at 4 ℃ until processing.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 1 week)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Permeabilization and Blocking  
5.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Primary Antibody Staining  
6.1 Incubation with anti-C-Fos (e.g., Santa Cruz sc-52, 1:500) and anti-Npas4 (e.g., Synaptic Systems 229 003, 1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking)  

7 Washing  
7.1 Wash with PBT six times.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours per wash)  

8 Secondary Antibody Staining  
8.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking)  

9 Post-staining Washes  
9.1 Wash with PBT six times.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours per wash)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
12.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

13 Sample Storage and Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Transfer cleared brain into glass vial filled with fresh DBE and seal tightly.(Temperature: RT, Time: store indefinitely in dark)  
13.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy for 3D acquisition.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 647, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The goal requires high-fidelity 3D mapping of neuronal somata and processes throughout the intact adult mouse brain—a large, lipid-rich tissue demanding strong delipidation and deep labeling penetration. uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for whole adult mouse brains, offering rapid, high-refractive-index matching, excellent transparency, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in uDISCO, so we use robust immunolabeling with pan-neuronal markers: NeuN for neuronal nuclei/somata and β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) for axons/dendrites. Both are well-validated, target-specific structural markers for neurons, and their conjugation to Alexa Fluor 647 and 488, respectively, ensures strong signal retention through uDISCO processing.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment removal)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% NGS): anti-NeuN (1:500) and anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer: Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) for NeuN and Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) for TUJ1.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-labeling Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer cleared brain into a glass imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)  
12.2 Seal chamber to prevent DBE evaporation; store at RT in the dark. Sample is now ready for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The original CUBIC protocol failed due to insufficient delipidation and slow reagent penetration in dense adult mouse whole brain (~10 mm scale), leading to inhomogeneous clearing and poor deep-tissue signal. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based method for this tissue tier (T04_WHOLE_MOUSE_BRAIN_5_12MM), offering strong delipidation, rapid and uniform clearing, and compatibility with antibody-based labeling using Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so direct use of FP reporters is unsuitable; instead, target-specific immediate early gene (IEG) markers C-Fos and Npas4—canonical activity-dependent nuclear markers—are labeled via primary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 and 647, respectively, which are fully compatible with iDISCO+. This strategy enables specific identification of two distinct activated neuron subpopulations while preserving 3D morphology sufficiently for registration and spatial clustering.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-C-Fos (e.g., Santa Cruz sc-52, 1:500) and anti-Npas4 (e.g., Synaptic Systems 229 003, 1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥2 hours or until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, DiI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D reconstruction of regenerating and spared axonal tracts across a 15-mm-long dense spinal cord segment. uDISCO is an established solvent-based clearing method for long CNS tracts (tier T06_LONG_CNS_OR_TUBULAR_15_80MM), offering strong delipidation, deep antibody/dye penetration, and compatibility with both lipophilic tracers (DiI) and far-red fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 647). DiI provides stable, diffusion-based labeling of intact and regenerating membrane structures over long distances without requiring immunostaining, while anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) immunolabeling with Alexa Fluor 647 specifically highlights neuronal/axonal cytoskeletons, including fine regenerative sprouts. Both labels are compatible with uDISCO’s organic solvent workflow and resist quenching, enabling robust signal retention in the injury core and penumbra.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.6 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Immunolabeling  
5.1 Incubation with blocking solution (PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with primary antibody: mouse anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) diluted 1:500 in PBT + 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)  
5.3 Wash with PBT (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
5.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:300 in PBT + 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)  
5.5 Wash with PBT (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

6 DiI Tracer Application (post-immunolabeling, pre-final dehydration)  
6.1 Under stereomicroscope, microinject DiI crystals or apply 1 µL of 5 mg/mL DiI in ethanol directly onto rostral and caudal cut ends of the spinal cord segment using fine glass capillary.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate application)  
6.2 Incubate in PBS at 37 ℃ in dark to allow DiI diffusion along membranes.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
6.3 Wash briefly with PBS to remove surface DiI.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)  

7 Final Dehydration  
7.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Refractive Index Matching  
8.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) hexane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma-Aldrich 112302).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

9 Sample Storage and Imaging Preparation  
9.1 Transfer sample into fresh ethyl cinnamate (ECi) in glass imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite storage in dark)  
9.2 Equilibrate at RT for ≥30 minutes before imaging to minimize refractive index gradients.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
