**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 647, DNA / Chromatin + TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is a high-refractive-index solvent-based clearing method established for dense human clinical tissue blocks (T09_HUMAN_DENSE_CLINICAL_BLOCK), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration within 24–48 hours—critical for rapid clinical assessment. It preserves the signal of Alexa Fluor 647 (compatible per knowledge base) and TO-PRO-3 (caution noted but acceptable with optimized incubation), enabling robust detection of epithelial cancer cells via Pan-Cytokeratin (a pan-epithelial marker specific for residual carcinoma) and nuclear morphology via TO-PRO-3 (superior to DAPI/Hoechst in uDISCO for chromatin contrast without severe quenching). This combination avoids reliance on endogenous GFP (quenched in many solvent methods) and leverages target-specific immunolabeling with a far-red fluorophore for deep imaging, while TO-PRO-3 provides high-contrast nuclear reference to assess spatial relationship to the true cut margin.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling (perform after fixation/post-fixation, before dehydration)  
1.1 Permeabilization with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with primary antibody anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (e.g., clone AE1/AE3, 1:200 dilution) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)  
1.4 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (3 × 1 hour).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
1.5 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500 dilution) + TO-PRO-3 (1 µM) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours)  
1.6 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (3 × 1 hour).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) + 33% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [p63 + Alexa Fluor 488, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous-based clearing method established for dense human clinical tissues (T09_HUMAN_DENSE_CLINICAL_BLOCK) that minimizes tissue shrinkage and preserves 3D morphology—critical for maintaining the 15 mm needle-core geometry and spatial relationships of prostate glands. It supports deep antibody penetration without harsh organic solvents (unlike FOCM/iDISCO+), thereby avoiding the excessive dehydration and RI mismatch-induced distortion observed previously. p63 specifically labels basal cells in prostate glands, while Pan-Cytokeratin robustly marks luminal and basal epithelial compartments; dual labeling enables clear discrimination of basal layer integrity versus loss—a key criterion in Gleason scoring. DAPI provides nuclear context without interfering with gland architecture. All fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488/568, DAPI) are fully compatible with Ce3D and retain strong signal post-clearing.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (if stored in ethanol or methanol)  
1.1 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with PBS only for 2 hours with gentle agitation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 10% normal goat serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: mouse anti-p63 (1:200) and rabbit anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200) in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 5% normal goat serum in PBS) for 5 days with gentle rotation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)  

4 Washing  
4.1 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) three times, 12 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours total)  

5 Secondary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: goat anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and goat anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), plus DAPI (1 µg/mL), in antibody dilution buffer for 3 days with gentle rotation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Post-Staining Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBST three times, 12 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours total)  

7 Ce3D Clearing  
7.1 Incubation with Ce3D-A solution (25% (wt/vol) fructose, 10% (wt/vol) α-thioglycerol, 0.1 M phosphate buffer, pH 7.4) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with Ce3D-B solution (50% (wt/vol) fructose, 20% (wt/vol) α-thioglycerol, 0.1 M phosphate buffer, pH 7.4) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
7.3 Incubation with Ce3D-C solution (75% (wt/vol) fructose, 30% (wt/vol) α-thioglycerol, 0.1 M phosphate buffer, pH 7.4) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

8 Refractive Index Matching and Storage  
8.1 Transfer tissue to imaging chamber filled with Ce3D-C solution for immediate light-sheet or confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: as needed for imaging)  
8.2 For long-term storage, keep samples immersed in Ce3D-C at 4 ℃ in the dark. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [p63 + Alexa Fluor 647, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D visualization of prostate gland architecture with specific discrimination of malignant epithelium (loss of basal layer) and tumor infiltration patterns. p63 is a well-established nuclear marker for basal cells in prostate glands; its absence indicates malignancy. Pan-Cytokeratin labels all epithelial cells, enabling delineation of glandular contours and identification of infiltrative or fused structures. DAPI provides nuclear context for gland morphology but is not used alone for diagnostic calls. iDISCO+ was selected because it offers strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration in dense human clinical tissue (T09_HUMAN_DENSE_CLINICAL_BLOCK), is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488/647 conjugates, and achieves high refractive index matching suitable for light-sheet imaging. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous FPs, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on immunofluorescence. Methanol-based dehydration also enhances antibody penetration in fixed needle-core biopsies.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (post-PFA fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with anti-p63 (mouse monoclonal, 1:200) and anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (rabbit polyclonal, 1:200) diluted in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 5% (vol/vol) NGS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

4 Wash  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 buffer changes)  

5 Secondary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 5% (vol/vol) NGS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

6 Post-staining Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, with 4 buffer changes)  

7 Nuclear Counterstain  
7.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Dehydration  
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

9 Delipidation  
9.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

10 Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
11.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
11.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy for 3D acquisition.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [p63 + Alexa Fluor 647, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D visualization of prostate gland architecture with specific distinction between basal cells (marked by p63) and luminal/adenocarcinoma epithelium (marked by Pan-Cytokeratin). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for dense human clinical biopsy cores (T09_HUMAN_DENSE_CLINICAL_BLOCK), offering strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on immunostaining. DAPI provides nuclear morphology context without interfering with target-specific signals. iDISCO+ achieves high transparency in ~5–7 days for 15 mm needle cores while preserving glandular geometry sufficiently for Gleason pattern assessment.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (post-PFA fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration for Immunostaining  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer: anti-p63 (1:200) + anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, each with fresh solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400) + donkey anti-rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:400).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-Staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, each with fresh solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration Prior to Delipidation  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

12 Nuclear Counterstain Integration (optional post-clearing DAPI if signal lost)  
12.1 If DAPI signal is weak, incubate cleared sample in 1 µg/mL DAPI in 100% methanol for 2 hours before step 9.1; otherwise, DAPI is retained from step 5/7 washes and no additional staining is needed.(Temperature: RT, Time: N/A unless applied)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-PNAd (MECA-79) + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires specific labeling of high endothelial venules (HEVs), for which PNAd (recognized by MECA-79 antibody) is the gold-standard marker in murine lymph nodes. CD31 provides pan-endothelial context to distinguish HEVs from other vascular structures. DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain to delineate lymphocyte-dense regions (cortex/medulla). iDISCO+ is selected because it offers strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration in dense, small whole tissues like lymph nodes (~2–3 mm), is established for this sample tier, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 568/647 dyes. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on robust immunofluorescence, making this limitation irrelevant. Organic solvent-based clearing ensures rapid, high-contrast imaging of fine HEV networks in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide (blocking buffer).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-PNAd (MECA-79, rat IgM) at 1:100 and anti-CD31 (rat or hamster IgG) at 1:100 in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rat IgM (Alexa Fluor 647) at 1:200 and donkey anti-rat/hamster IgG (Alexa Fluor 568) at 1:200 in blocking buffer + 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Nuclear Counterstain  
9.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Mount cleared lymph node in glass-bottom dish or capillary filled with DBE, sealed with coverslip and nail polish to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [MECA-79 (anti-PNAd) + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for small, dense immune organs like lymph nodes (2–3 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration while preserving synthetic fluorophores such as Alexa Fluor dyes. It is compatible with DAPI and allows high-resolution 3D imaging of vascular networks. PNAd (recognized by MECA-79) is the gold-standard marker for high endothelial venules (HEVs) in lymphoid tissue, providing specificity beyond pan-endothelial CD31. CD31 labels all vascular endothelium, enabling contextual mapping of HEVs within the full vasculature. DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain to delineate lymphocyte-dense cortical, paracortical, and medullary zones without requiring additional cell-type-specific antibodies, aligning with the goal of spatial relationship analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling (post-fixation, pre-clearing)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to reduce non-specific binding. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-mouse PNAd (MECA-79, BioLegend, 1:100) and rat anti-mouse CD31 (BD Pharmingen, 1:100) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (1% normal goat serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle agitation)  
1.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: goat anti-rat IgM Alexa Fluor 647 (for MECA-79) and goat anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 568 (for CD31), both at 1:200 in antibody dilution buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours with gentle agitation)  
1.5 Wash with PBST three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) to label nuclei. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation and Bleaching  
3.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh from 30% H₂O₂ stock). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  

4 Rehydration (reverse methanol series)  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with 100% THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.4 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.5 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
5.6 Incubation with benzyl alcohol : benzyl benzoate (BABB, 1:2 vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.7 Final incubation in BABB for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour or until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [MECA-79 (anti-PNAd) + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 488, Hoechst 33342]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for high clearing power in dense, lipid-rich tissues like lymph nodes while preserving fluorescence of synthetic dyes and Alexa Fluor conjugates. It is established for small whole organs (1–5 mm) and enables deep antibody penetration—critical for labeling HEV-specific addressin (PNAd, recognized by MECA-79) and pan-endothelial marker CD31. PNAd is the gold-standard target-specific marker for HEVs in murine lymph nodes, distinguishing them from general vasculature labeled by CD31. Hoechst provides nuclear counterstain to assess lymphocyte density gradients without interfering with HEV/vascular signals. FDISCO maintains signal integrity of Alexa Fluor 488/647 and Hoechst, unlike iDISCO+, and avoids the slower kinetics of aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, MACS), which may compromise morphology in dense lymphoid tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigment present)  
2.1 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-PNAd (MECA-79, BioLegend 120902) at 1:100 and anti-CD31 (PECAM1, BioLegend 102402) at 1:200 in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 four more times, total 5 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgM (for MECA-79) at 1:500 and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG (for CD31) at 1:500 in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours, dark, gentle agitation)  

8 Nuclear Counterstaining  
8.1 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, dark)  

9 Post-staining Washes  
9.1 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, dark)  
9.2 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, dark)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation and Clearing  
11.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma 112372).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

13 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Transfer sample to imaging chamber filled with fresh ECi for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at RT in sealed vial for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** MACS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [MECA-79 (anti-PNAd) + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568, Hoechst 33342]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires specific labeling of high endothelial venules (HEVs), which are best identified by the addressin PNAd (recognized by MECA-79 antibody), not by pan-endothelial markers alone. CD31 provides complementary pan-vascular endothelial context. Given the small size (2–3 mm) and dense lymphoid architecture of murine inguinal lymph nodes, an aqueous, low-distortion clearing method that preserves antigenicity and enables deep antibody penetration is essential. MACS is established for T03_SMALL_WHOLE_SAMPLE_1_5MM, uses non-denaturing conditions, maintains fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes and Hoechst, and avoids the harsh organic solvents in iDISCO+/uDISCO that likely caused HEV signal loss and high background in the prior protocol. Hoechst provides nuclear counterstain to delineate lymphocyte-rich zones without interfering with HEV/endothelial signals. Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 are fully compatible with MACS and offer minimal spectral overlap for multiplexed imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration (optional pre-clearing equilibration)  
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) for gentle permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Primary Antibody Labeling  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-mouse PNAd (MECA-79, 1:100) and rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:100), diluted in PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days with gentle agitation)  

3 Wash  
3.1 Incubation with PBST (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

4 Secondary Antibody Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rat IgM (for MECA-79) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200) and donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:200), diluted in PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 days with gentle agitation)  

5 Wash  
5.1 Incubation with PBST (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

6 Nuclear Counterstaining  
6.1 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 in PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)  

7 Final Wash  
7.1 Incubation with PBS (2 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

8 Tissue Optical Clearing  
8.1 Incubation with MACS-R0 (20 vol% MXDA, 15% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.40).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with MACS-R1 (40 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.48).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.51).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

9 Refractive Index Matching and Storage  
9.1 Transfer sample to fresh MACS-R2 for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 647, GL7+Alexa Fluor 568, PNA-Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for visualizing B cell follicles and germinal centers throughout the intact spleen. It efficiently clears lipid-rich lymphoid tissue while preserving 3D architecture with acceptable shrinkage. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched, so all labeling must be dye- or antibody-based; iDISCO+ is fully compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes (488, 568, 647) and tolerates DAPI with caution. B220 robustly labels all B cells in follicles; GL7 marks activated B cells in germinal centers; PNA-Lectin (from *Arachis hypogaea*) specifically binds glycans enriched in germinal center dark zones, providing structural contrast to delineate GC boundaries. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for spatial context and cell density estimation. This multi-channel strategy enables precise 3D mapping of follicle size, GC position, cellular density, and inter-follicular heterogeneity.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spleen due to heme pigment)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-B220 (1:200), anti-GL7 (1:100) in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 3% (vol/vol) donkey serum in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Wash with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS) × 5 changes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody + Lectin + Nuclear Stain  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rat IgG-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300), donkey anti-rat IgM-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300), plus PNA-Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (10 µg/mL), and DAPI (5 µg/mL) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Wash with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS) × 5 changes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)

**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 647, CD19+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of B cell follicles within intact mouse spleen (~15 mm), a dense lymphoid organ with high lipid content. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM samples, offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes—critical for robust labeling of B cell-specific markers. Endogenous fluorescence is not relied upon; instead, we use two complementary B cell lineage markers: B220 (pan-B cell marker enriched in follicles) and CD19 (mature B cell surface marker), both validated for spleen white pulp architecture. Alexa Fluor 647 and 568 are highly compatible with iDISCO+, resistant to quenching, and enable multiplexed 3D imaging of follicle morphology and spatial distribution. Nuclear counterstains are omitted as primary markers, per constraints.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spleen autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two additional times, each with fresh solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)

8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two additional times, each with fresh solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 647, GL7+Alexa Fluor 488, PNA-Lectin+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The spleen is a highly pigmented, lipid-rich organ (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH), requiring a high-clearing-power solvent-based method. iDISCO+ provides strong delipidation and efficient hemoglobin decolorization, critical for resolving deep structures like germinal centers in intact spleens. It supports deep antibody and lectin penetration and is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes (488, 568, 647), which are photostable and ideal for multichannel 3D imaging. B220 labels all B cells to delineate follicles; GL7 specifically marks activated B cells in germinal centers; PNA-Lectin binds glycans enriched in germinal center B cells, providing complementary structural confirmation. Endogenous fluorescence is avoided due to quenching by iDISCO+, so all labeling uses exogenous, compatible fluorophores. Skipping gradient delipidation (as in prior Ce3D attempt) compromises clearing—iDISCO+ includes mandatory graded dehydration and delipidation, ensuring full decolorization and refractive index homogenization.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Decolorization  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody and Lectin Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies and lectin: anti-B220 (1:200), anti-GL7 (1:100), and biotinylated PNA-Lectin (10 µg/mL) in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Streptavidin Conjugate Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies and streptavidin: donkey anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300), donkey anti-rat IgM–Alexa Fluor 488 (1:300), and streptavidin–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 647, GL7+Alexa Fluor 568, CD35+Alexa Fluor 488, TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method with high delipidation power and deep antibody penetration, ideal for dense, fixed mouse spleen (~15 mm) requiring whole-organ 3D mapping of immune structures. It preserves morphology sufficiently for spatial analysis of white pulp architecture while enabling robust immunolabeling of B cell follicles (via B220), germinal centers (via GL7), and follicular dendritic cell networks/marginal zones (via CD35). TO-PRO-3 provides a stable nuclear counterstain compatible with iDISCO+ (used cautiously but validated in lymphoid tissue) to assess cellular density and demarcate red vs. white pulp. Alexa Fluor dyes (488/568/647) are fully compatible with iDISCO+ and offer minimal quenching during dehydration and clearing.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching (optional but recommended for spleen due to heme content)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-B220 (rat IgG2b, 1:200), anti-GL7 (rat IgM, 1:100), and anti-CD35 (rat IgG2a, 1:100) diluted in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat 6.1 two more times with fresh buffer each time.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rat IgG (H+L) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400), Alexa Fluor 568 (1:400), and Alexa Fluor 488 (1:400), all diluted in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat 8.1 two more times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Nuclear Counterstaining  
9.1 Incubation with TO-PRO-3 (1:1000 in PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Repeat 11.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

13 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Store cleared spleen immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
13.2 Mount sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate prior to imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD8 + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires deep, high-fidelity immunolabeling of T cell subsets (pan-T via CD3; cytotoxic T via CD8) and vascular reference (CD31) in a dense, fixed ~8 mm tumor. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for mouse soft organs of this size (T05 tier), offering strong delipidation, excellent antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes (488, 568, 647)—all critical for multiplexed 3D immune mapping. Although it quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on exogenous antibodies conjugated to stable synthetic fluorophores, which are fully compatible. iDISCO+ also provides rapid clearing with minimal background, enabling high-resolution light-sheet imaging of spatial T cell gradients relative to vasculature and necrotic zones.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for pigmented tumors)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (or species-matched blocking serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD3 (e.g., 1:200), anti-CD8 (e.g., 1:200), anti-CD31 (e.g., 1:200) diluted in PBST + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 488 (for CD3), anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (for CD8), anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (for CD31), all at 1:500 dilution in PBST + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour or until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD8 + Alexa Fluor 647, Hoechst 33342]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires deep, high-fidelity 3D mapping of total T cells (via CD3) and cytotoxic T cells (via CD8) within a dense, fixed ~8 mm³ mouse subcutaneous tumor. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for this tissue tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering strong delipidation power, excellent antibody penetration into dense tumor stroma, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 and 647—both robust against organic solvents used in iDISCO+. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling relies on exogenous antibody-conjugated dyes, which are fully compatible. Hoechst 33342 is included as a nuclear counterstain to delineate tumor architecture (core vs. periphery) and assess cellularity; while “caution” is noted for Hoechst in iDISCO+, empirical protocols confirm its retention when added post-clearing during RI matching. This combination enables precise spatial quantification of T-cell infiltration depth and immune “hot/cold” status.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching (optional for pigmented tumors; include if sample shows melanin/heme)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking

4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.1 Incubation with anti-CD3 (e.g., clone 17A2, 1:200) and anti-CD8 (e.g., clone 53-6.7, 1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-CD31 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The浦肯野纤维 network is specifically and robustly labeled by Contactin-2 (Cntn2), a validated marker for Purkinje fibers in mouse heart. To preserve spatial context, CD31 immunostaining visualizes the coronary vasculature as an anatomical reference without substituting the primary target. uDISCO was selected because it provides high clearing power for dense, lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like fixed mouse hearts (~10 mm scale), enables deep antibody penetration via organic solvent-based delipidation, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 647/568 dyes. Although uDISCO causes moderate tissue shrinkage, it maintains sufficient morphological fidelity for 3D network analysis of Purkinje fiber architecture at whole-organ scale. Endogenous fluorescence is not relied upon, so FP quenching is irrelevant; instead, stable synthetic fluorophores ensure signal retention through dehydration and high-RI matching.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for heme-rich cardiac tissue)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 5% (wt/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Cntn2 (1:200) and anti-CD31 (1:100) diluted in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (wt/vol) normal goat serum + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (wt/vol) normal goat serum + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Cx40 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity visualization of two specific molecular components of the cardiac conduction system—Contactin-2 (Cntn2) for Purkinje fiber identity and Connexin 40 (Cx40) for gap junctions in the specialized conduction network—in a dense, lipid-rich whole mouse heart (~10 mm scale). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM samples, offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488/568 dyes. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling relies on exogenous immunostaining with robust, photostable Alexa Fluor conjugates, which are explicitly compatible with iDISCO+. This method enables high-resolution 3D imaging of fine Purkinje network architecture across ventricular regions while preserving spatial relationships critical for assessing co-localization and continuity.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction in fixed heart)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Cntn2 (1:200) and anti-Cx40 (1:200) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat PBT wash five more times, each for 1 hour at RT with gentle agitation.  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat (for Cntn2) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-rabbit (for Cx40), each at 1:400 dilution in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat PBT wash five more times, each for 1 hour at RT with gentle agitation.  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat 100% DCM incubation once more.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)

12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in glass vial protected from light at RT. Sample is ready for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-CD31 + Alexa Fluor 568, TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method with high delipidation power and deep antibody penetration, ideal for dense, lipid-rich tissues like the intact mouse heart (~10 mm scale). It effectively clears whole organs within days while preserving robust synthetic fluorophores (e.g., Alexa Fluor dyes). Endogenous FPs are quenched, so target-specific immunolabeling is required. Cntn2 (Contactin-2) is a well-established molecular marker selectively expressed in Purkinje fibers of the cardiac conduction system, enabling specific identification beyond generic structural labels. CD31 provides vascular reference for spatial orientation, and TO-PRO-3 (a far-red nuclear stain compatible with iDISCO+) offers cellular context without significant signal loss. This combination allows precise 3D mapping of Purkinje fiber architecture relative to endocardium, septum, papillary muscles, and apex.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Cntn2 (1:200) and anti-CD31 (1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400) in PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, gentle shaking)  

8 Nuclear Counterstaining  
8.1 Incubation with TO-PRO-3 (1:1000) in PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Post-staining Wash  
9.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 4 buffer changes)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Transfer cleared heart into fresh DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 568, anti-Cx40 / Hcn4 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The dense, lipid-rich mouse heart requires a high-clearing-power solvent-based method; iDISCO+ is established for whole mouse organs of this size (T05 tier), enables deep antibody penetration, and effectively removes lipids and heme pigments that cause background. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, the protocol uses exogenous Alexa Fluor–conjugated secondary antibodies, which are fully compatible (Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 are stable in iDISCO+). Cntn2 (Contactin-2) is a specific marker for Purkinje fibers, while Cx40/Hcn4 co-labeling identifies the conduction system’s gap junctions and pacemaker-like components—both essential for reconstructing the network. Red/far-red channels minimize tissue autofluorescence from myocardium and residual heme.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (Heme/autofluorescence removal)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Cntn2 (1:200) and anti-Cx40 / Hcn4 (1:100) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400) and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 568, TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D quantification of all glomeruli in intact mouse kidneys, including podocyte-specific structures and capillary loops. Podocin (NPHS2) is a highly specific足细胞 marker essential for identifying the filtration slit diaphragm; CD31 labels endothelial cells to delineate glomerular capillary tufts; TO-PRO-3 provides nuclear counterstain with better compatibility in organic solvent–based clearing than DAPI/Hoechst for this target set. iDISCO+ was selected because it offers strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration in dense, lipid-rich organs like kidney (~10 mm scale), is established for whole mouse soft organs (T05 tier), and preserves Alexa Fluor 568/647 signals effectively. Although it quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on exogenous antibody-dye conjugates, making this limitation irrelevant. Its relatively fast processing time (days vs. weeks) supports high-throughput comparative analysis in disease models.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Podocin (NPHS2) rabbit polyclonal (1:200) and anti-CD31 (PECAM1) rat monoclonal (1:100) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two additional times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300) and donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two additional times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

9 Nuclear Counterstaining  
9.1 Incubation with TO-PRO-3 iodide (1 µM) in PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

10 Wash  
10.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.2 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
11.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

12 Delipidation  
12.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
12.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
12.3 Repeat step 12.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

13 Refractive Index Matching  
13.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
13.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)
