**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 647, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and high refractive index matching while preserving exogenous fluorophores like Alexa Fluor dyes. It supports deep antibody penetration required for whole-kidney labeling of foot process slit diaphragm components (Nephrin and Podocin) and allows co-labeling with vascular lumen markers. Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 directly labels perfused glomerular capillary lumens without requiring transgenic reporters, fulfilling the requirement for vessel-assisted channel. FDISCO maintains signal intensity of Alexa Fluor 488/568/647 and minimizes quenching compared to iDISCO+, making it optimal for multi-channel 3D quantification of glomerular architecture in nephritis models.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (post-PFA fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Labeling  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Nephrin (1:200), anti-Podocin (1:200) in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
3.2 Wash with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS) – 5 changes over 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

4 Secondary Antibody and Lectin Co-labeling  
4.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:300), Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-goat (1:300), and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Lectin (Griffonia simplicifolia IB4, 1:200) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
4.2 Wash with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS) – 5 changes over 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

5 Dehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 90% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
5.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Delipidation  
6.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Repeat incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma 112372-100G).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with fresh ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
8.2 Mount in ECi-compatible imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy without additional washing.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D visualization of the slit diaphragm’s two core transmembrane proteins—Nephrin and Podocin—in intact, fixed mouse kidneys (~10 mm scale). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for dense soft organs in the T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM tier, offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488/568 dyes. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on immunostaining with validated primary antibodies against Nephrin and Podocin—both target-specific markers essential for assessing slit diaphragm integrity. iDISCO+’s relatively fast processing and high refractive index matching enable whole-kidney imaging with minimal signal loss, critical for quantifying focal disruptions across hundreds of glomeruli.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for kidney autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit monoclonal antibody (1:200) and anti-Podocin (NPHS2) goat polyclonal antibody (1:200) in PBT + 5% normal donkey serum + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) in PBT + 5% normal donkey serum + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer kidney to glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE; orient for optimal glomerular field coverage.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (T05 tier) that provides strong delipidation and uniform transparency across cortex and medulla—addressing the user’s issue of regional heterogeneity. It preserves Alexa Fluor dyes with high fidelity, enabling robust dual-signal detection of slit diaphragm proteins Nephrin and Podocin, while CD31 labels glomerular endothelium to aid boundary delineation. Unlike CUBIC (aqueous, slower, incomplete delipidation in medulla), FDISCO achieves full-kidney homogeneity in days. Endogenous fluorescence is not relied upon; all targets are labeled via compatible Alexa Fluor-conjugated antibodies, ensuring deep penetration and structural preservation critical for accurate glomerular volume quantification and 3D morphometry.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunolabeling (performed in methanol series for enhanced penetration)  
2.1 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.3 Rehydration: Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.4 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.5 Blocking: Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)  
2.6 Primary antibody incubation: anti-Nephrin (1:200), anti-Podocin (1:200), anti-CD31 (1:100) in antibody dilution buffer (1% normal donkey serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)  
2.7 Wash: Incubation with PBST (0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeated 5 times over 24 hours)  
2.8 Secondary antibody incubation: Alexa Fluor 488–donkey anti-rabbit (1:300), Alexa Fluor 568–donkey anti-goat (1:300), Alexa Fluor 647–rat anti-rat (1:300) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  
2.9 Wash: Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeated 4 times over 24 hours, protected from light)  

3 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Transfer cleared kidney into glass vial filled with fresh ethyl cinnamate (ECi) and seal.(Temperature: RT, protected from light, indefinite storage)  
6.2 Mount sample in ECi-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy for whole-kidney 3D acquisition.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19 (导管) + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D visualization of the entire biliary tree in a large, blood-rich mouse liver (~20 mm scale). CK19 is a well-established, specific epithelial marker for bile ducts across all branching levels (from large ducts to cholangioles), making it ideal for mapping structural changes post-injury. CD31 labels vascular endothelium and provides anatomical reference for portal tracts without substituting for biliary labeling. iDISCO+ was selected because it offers strong delipidation and clearing power for dense, lipid- and pigment-rich organs like the liver, enables deep antibody penetration in whole-mount samples of this size, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 568/647 dyes—both of which are robust under organic solvent-based clearing. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on immunostaining with stable synthetic fluorophores, avoiding this limitation. The method achieves sufficient transparency within days while preserving 3D architecture critical for quantitative morphometry of branching networks.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for blood-rich liver)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:200) and anti-CD31 (1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle shaking)

6.1 Wash with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Final wash with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) for CK19 and donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) for CD31, diluted in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Wash with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Final wash with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)

Alexa Fluor 647/568/488 are all compatible with iDISCO+, enabling multichannel imaging of biliary architecture and portal zone context without signal quenching.

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19 (导管)+Alexa Fluor 647, CK7+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D reconstruction of the biliary epithelial network in a large (~20 mm), blood-rich mouse liver with minimal misassignment of non-biliary structures. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for dense soft organs (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM) that provides strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for whole-liver immunolabeling. It effectively removes hemoglobin-derived background while preserving tissue architecture sufficiently for morphometric analysis of ductal remodeling. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so we use robust Alexa Fluor–conjugated antibodies: CK19 and CK7 are well-validated, complementary markers of biliary epithelium (with CK19 being more specific to reactive/proliferating ducts), enabling cross-confirmation of ductal identity. CD31 (Alexa Fluor 488) labels vascular endothelium to distinguish portal vasculature from adjacent bile ducts, preventing misinterpretation. All chosen fluorophores (AF488, AF568, AF647) are compatible with iDISCO+ per compatibility data, and nuclear dyes (e.g., DAPI) are avoided due to high autofluorescence and non-specificity in liver parenchyma.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (hemoglobin removal)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary antibody labeling  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum: anti-CK19 (1:200), anti-CK7 (1:200), anti-CD31 (1:100).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two additional times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

7 Secondary antibody labeling  
7.1 Incubation with species-specific secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (anti-rat, for CK19), Alexa Fluor 568 (anti-rabbit, for CK7), and Alexa Fluor 488 (anti-rat, for CD31), each at 1:400 dilution in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Wash with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two additional times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive index matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Storage and imaging preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in glass vial protected from light at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy, ensuring no air bubbles.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate prior to imaging)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19+Alexa Fluor 647, CK7+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS is specifically validated for dense, pigment-rich, and lipid-rich tissues like whole mouse liver (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH tier), offering strong decoloration and high refractive index matching suitable for deep imaging of intact organs. It preserves Alexa Fluor 647 and tolerates Alexa Fluor 568 with caution—sufficient for robust immunolabeling of structural epithelial markers. CK19 and CK7 are well-established, specific markers for biliary epithelial cells across physiological and injury states, enabling dual-channel reconstruction of the entire ductal tree. Endogenous fluorescence is not relied upon, avoiding quenching issues. Extended decoloration and methanol steps correct the prior protocol’s insufficient pigment removal.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.6 Repeat 100% (vol/vol) methanol incubation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Decoloration  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (wt/vol) BSA, 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:200) and anti-CK7 (1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (1% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 0.02% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300) and donkey anti-mouse IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.3 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.6 Repeat 100% (vol/vol) methanol incubation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Delipidation and Clearing  
10.1 Incubation with PEGASOS-A solution (10% (wt/vol) PEG 20000, 10% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (vol/vol) glycerol, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium deoxycholate in water).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)  
10.2 Incubation with PEGASOS-B solution (50% (wt/vol) PEG 20000, 20% (wt/vol) urea, 20% (vol/vol) glycerol in water).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

11.1 Incubation with PEGASOS-C solution (80% (wt/vol) PEG 20000, 30% (wt/vol) urea, 30% (vol/vol) glycerol in water, RI ≈ 1.46).(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to fresh PEGASOS-C in a glass imaging chamber.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)  
12.2 Store protected from light at RT; image within 2 weeks using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission filters for Alexa Fluor 568 and Alexa Fluor 647.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 647, SM22α + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires specific, unambiguous identification of airway smooth muscle (ASM) across all airway generations in a thick (~10 mm), lipid-rich mouse lung lobe. α-SMA and SM22α are well-established, target-specific markers for ASM that distinguish it from other actin-rich structures (e.g., endothelial or epithelial cells). F-actin probes alone are insufficient per the problem constraints. iDISCO+ is selected because it provides strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration in dense soft organs like lung, is established for T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM samples, and preserves Alexa Fluor 568/647 signals effectively. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous FPs, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on immunostaining with compatible synthetic fluorophores. Its organic solvent-based protocol ensures high refractive index matching and uniform clearing across air-filled parenchyma.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for lung autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-α-SMA (1:200) and anti-SM22α (1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% donkey serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400) and donkey anti-rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 568 (1:400) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE in imaging-compatible glass vial.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour prior to imaging)

12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark. Image within 7 days using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission filters for Alexa Fluor 568 (Ex/Em ~578/603 nm) and Alexa Fluor 647 (Ex/Em ~650/668 nm).

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for visualizing thick, lipid-rich lung tissue and achieving uniform labeling of both airway smooth muscle and intrapulmonary nerves. It effectively clears autofluorescence while preserving robust synthetic fluorophores like Alexa Fluor 568/647. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so target-specific immunolabeling is required. α-SMA (alpha-smooth muscle actin) is a well-validated, specific marker for airway smooth muscle cells, enabling accurate assessment of remodeling. PGP9.5 (protein gene product 9.5, aka UCHL1) is a pan-neuronal cytoplasmic marker widely used to label pulmonary vagal nerve fibers with high specificity. Both primary antibodies are compatible with organic solvent-based protocols when paired with Alexa Fluor dyes, which remain stable through iDISCO+ processing.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-α-SMA (1:200) and anti-PGP9.5 (1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, gentle shaking)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-labeling Washing  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five more times (total 6 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The mouse lung lobe is a lipid- and pigment-rich (T10) tissue requiring strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration. iDISCO+ provides high clearing power, rapid processing, and excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes for robust immunolabeling in dense tissues. Endogenous fluorescence is not required; instead, we use α-SMA (a canonical marker of airway smooth muscle) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 for specific identification, and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 to label F-actin for structural reference of cytoskeletal architecture and airway wall morphology. This dual-labeling strategy enables precise segmentation of smooth muscle layers across branching airways while preserving geometric fidelity for quantitative 3D analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for pigmented samples)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-α-SMA primary antibody (e.g., clone 1A4, 1:200 dilution) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Co-staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated Phalloidin (1:200) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours total)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage or immediate imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 647, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires precise 3D quantification of all β cells in the intact mouse pancreas, necessitating deep antibody penetration and high clearing power for a lipid-rich, soft organ (~15 mm). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based method for this tissue tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering strong delipidation, rapid clearing, and excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so we use target-specific primary antibodies against Insulin (definitive β-cell marker) and PDX1 (pancreatic progenitor/β-cell nuclear co-marker) conjugated to photostable, iDISCO+-compatible Alexa Fluor 647 and 568, respectively. This dual-labeling strategy ensures unambiguous identification of β cells while avoiding reliance on non-specific nuclear stains like DAPI/Hoechst as primary markers.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Insulin (e.g., guinea pig anti-Insulin, 1:500) and anti-PDX1 (e.g., rabbit anti-PDX1, 1:500) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥24 hours)  

12 Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer cleared pancreas into a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE, orienting for optimal light-sheet or confocal acquisition.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 488, SM22α + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires deep, uniform clearing of intact mouse lung lobes (~10 mm scale) with strong preservation of fine airway architecture and robust dual-labeling of airway smooth muscle (ASM). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based method for dense soft organs (T05 tier), offering high delipidation power, excellent antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes—critical since endogenous fluorescence is unreliable in fixed lung tissue. α-SMA and SM22α are canonical, target-specific markers for ASM; their co-staining enables cross-validation of remodeling metrics (thickness, continuity, hyperplasia). PGP9.5 provides specific labeling of pulmonary vagal nerves for spatial reference. iDISCO+’s methanol dehydration and dichloromethane (DCM)-based delipidation effectively reduce blood-derived pigments and lipid-induced scattering, addressing the user’s prior issues with uneven transparency and weak signal. Although iDISCO+ quenches GFP/RFP, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous Alexa Fluor-conjugated antibodies, which are fully compatible.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

6.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

8.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for strong delipidation and high refractive index matching in dense, lipid-rich organs like the pancreas (size ~15 mm), enabling deep antibody penetration and whole-organ transparency with minimal fluorescence quenching. It preserves signals from Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI—critical for robust detection of insulin (mature β-cell marker) and PDX1 (key β-cell transcription factor)—while allowing nuclear counterstaining to delineate islet boundaries and support volumetric quantification. Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, ScaleS), FDISCO achieves faster and more complete clearing in thick soft organs without significant swelling, preserving 3D morphology essential for accurate β-cell volume calculation.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if tissue has pigmentation)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Insulin (1:500) and anti-PDX1 (1:300) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three times, changing solution each time.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-guinea pig (for Insulin) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-rabbit (for PDX1), both at 1:500, in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)  

8 Nuclear Counterstain  
8.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

9 Wash  
9.1 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Repeat wash step 9.1 two more times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

10 Dehydration (post-staining)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Repeat step 11.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

13 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Store sample in 100% (vol/vol) ECi at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
13.2 Mount sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with ECi for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** The original CUBIC protocol caused severe islet disruption and weak hormone signal, likely due to excessive delipidation (96 h at 45°C) in an aqueous system that inadequately preserves protein epitopes and fluorescent signals in lipid-rich pancreatic tissue. FDISCO—a solvent-based, high-clearing-power method—offers superior delipidation efficiency with controlled dehydration, better preservation of insulin and nuclear antigens, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI. It minimizes structural distortion in soft organs like the pancreas compared to harsher solvent methods (e.g., uDISCO/iDISCO+), while maintaining strong fluorescence intensity for quantitative 3D imaging. Insulin (β-cell hormone product) and PDX1 (key β-cell transcription factor) provide complementary, target-specific dual labeling essential for accurate β-cell identification and volumetric quantification across the entire organ.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Insulin (1:500) and anti-PDX1 (1:250) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 three more times, total 4 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-guinea pig (for Insulin) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-rabbit (for PDX1), both at 1:500, plus DAPI (1 µg/mL), in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 three more times, total 4 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for imaging storage.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour or until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of sympathetic innervation in lipid-rich white adipose tissue. Sympathetic fibers are specifically marked by tyrosine hydroxylase (TH), the rate-limiting enzyme in catecholamine synthesis, making anti-TH immunostaining the gold-standard target-specific marker. Vascular reference is provided by CD31 to contextualize perivascular nerve distribution. uDISCO is selected because it is a high-clearing-power solvent-based method validated for large, lipid-rich tissues like intact fat pads; it enables deep antibody penetration, achieves high refractive index matching (>1.52), and preserves far-red fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 647/568) critical for imaging thick samples with minimal scattering. Endogenous FPs are quenched in uDISCO, so dye-conjugated antibodies are essential—this aligns with our labeling strategy. Tissue shrinkage is acceptable given the focus on relative spatial relationships rather than absolute morphometrics.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for lipid-rich tissue to reduce autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh from 30% H₂O₂ stock).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-TH (1:200) and anti-CD31 (1:100) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300) and donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Repeat wash with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥2 hours or until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH + Alexa Fluor 488, NPY + Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires distinguishing norepinephrine-releasing (TH⁺) sympathetic fibers from peptidergic (NPY⁺) sympathetic fibers in intact white adipose tissue—a lipid-rich, dense sample (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for such tissues, offering strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so primary antibodies against target markers conjugated to compatible Alexa Fluor dyes are used: TH (tyrosine hydroxylase) labels all catecholaminergic sympathetic fibers; NPY (neuropeptide Y) marks the peptidergic subset; CD31 delineates vasculature for regional analysis (perivascular zones). Alexa Fluor 488, 568, and 647 are all compatible with iDISCO+ and allow multiplexed 3D imaging of fiber subtypes across anatomical compartments.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for lipid-rich tissue with residual heme)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-TH (1:200), anti-NPY (1:200), and anti-CD31 (1:100) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washes Post Primary  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)

8.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH + Alexa Fluor 568, Lectin (from Lycopersicon esculentum) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The sample is a lipid-rich white adipose tissue (WAT) pad (~15 mm), requiring a high-clearing-power solvent-based method. iDISCO+ is established for dense, lipid-rich tissues and enables deep antibody/dye penetration with relatively fast processing. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so we use immunolabeling for the sympathetic nerve marker tyrosine hydroxylase (TH)—the rate-limiting enzyme in norepinephrine synthesis and a definitive marker for sympathetic fibers in WAT—and vascular labeling via perfusion-compatible tomato lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, which binds endothelial glycocalyx and labels patent vasculature lumens. Both Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 are compatible with iDISCO+. This combination allows precise 3D mapping of sympathetic innervation relative to the vascular scaffold.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for lipid-rich tissue with residual heme)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared by mixing 1 volume 30% H₂O₂ with 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.1 Incubation with anti-TH primary antibody (e.g., rabbit anti-TH, 1:200–1:500) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody (donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568, 1:500) and tomato lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (50–100 µg/mL) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (e.g., *Griffonia simplicifolia* Lectin I, GSL I) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, IB4 conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for high-lipid, pigment-rich tissues like placenta, offering strong delipidation and deep dye penetration while preserving fluorescence of synthetic dyes such as Alexa Fluor conjugates. It is compatible with lectin/IB4 labeling—ideal for perfused vascular lumens—and supports nuclear counterstaining with DAPI. Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, ScaleS), FDISCO efficiently removes hemoglobin-derived pigments that cause background in blood-rich placental tissue, enabling high-contrast 3D imaging of dense绒毛血管树. Its refractive index (~1.52) matches common light-sheet objectives, and it minimizes signal loss in the tissue core—critical for visualizing terminal capillaries in thick (~3 mm) whole placenta samples.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Based Vascular Labeling (post-fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 100 µg/mL *Griffonia simplicifolia* Lectin I (GSL I) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 and 100 µg/mL *Isolectin B4* (IB4) from *Griffonia simplicifolia* conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 in PBS containing 1% (wt/vol) bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

2 Nuclear Counterstaining  
2.1 Incubation with 5 µg/mL DAPI in PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Wash with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Bleaching (Hemoglobin/Pigment Removal)  
4.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂, 30% stock) in 100% methanol. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Rehydration (for optional post-clearing immunostaining; skip if only lectin/DAPI used)  
*(Skipped in this protocol since labeling is complete pre-clearing)*  

6 Delipidation and Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.2 Transfer to fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Store samples immersed in DBE in glass vials protected from light at RT. Samples are stable for ≥1 month. Prior to light-sheet or confocal imaging, equilibrate at RT for 30 minutes.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH + Alexa Fluor 488, NPY + Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The target is to distinguish noradrenergic (TH⁺) from peptidergic (NPY⁺) sympathetic nerve fibers in intact, lipid-rich mouse epididymal white adipose tissue (WAT). iDISCO+ is ideal for high-lipid tissues due to its strong organic solvent–based delipidation and efficient refractive index (RI) matching, enabling deep antibody penetration and high clearing efficacy. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so we use directly conjugated Alexa Fluor dyes—compatible with iDISCO+ per the knowledge base—for robust, stable labeling of TH (tyrosine hydroxylase, marker of catecholaminergic fibers), NPY (neuropeptide Y, marker of peptidergic sympathetic fibers), and CD31 (to visualize vasculature for perivascular enrichment analysis). Skipping methanol dehydration—as in the failed PEGASOS attempt—causes poor delipidation and flotation; iDISCO+ mandates a full methanol gradient to ensure complete dehydration and lipid removal, which is critical for RI homogeneity and sinking in DBE.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching / Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-TH (1:200), anti-NPY (1:200), and anti-CD31 (1:100) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining (if needed – but here using directly conjugated primaries)  
*Skipped – all primary antibodies pre-conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (TH), Alexa Fluor 568 (NPY), Alexa Fluor 647 (CD31)*  

8 Dehydration (post-staining)  
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

9 Delipidation (final)  
9.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Repeat incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

10 Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Imaging Preparation  
11.1 Transfer sample to glass-bottom imaging dish filled with fresh DBE; ensure tissue is fully submerged and oriented for optimal z-stack acquisition.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at RT in dark for ≤7 days)
