**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, IB4+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based high-refractive-index clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration while preserving fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes and lectins—critical for triple-labeling of slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin/Podocin) and glomerular capillary lumens (IB4). Unlike iDISCO+, FDISCO maintains compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488/568/647 and IB4, enabling robust signal retention in thick kidney tissue. Its rapid processing minimizes distortion, supporting accurate 3D spatial mapping of glomeruli across cortical zones.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigment present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit polyclonal (1:200) + anti-Podocin (NPHS2) mouse monoclonal (1:200) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 five times, total Time: 6 hours  

7 Secondary Antibody + Lectin Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) + Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) + Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated IB4 (10 µg/mL) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 five times, total Time: 6 hours  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma 112372-50ML).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh ECi for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D + Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method with high delipidation power and deep antibody penetration, ideal for dense, long tubular tissues like the intact mouse colon (6–8 cm). It effectively clears lipid-rich gut tissue while preserving 3D architecture of layered intestinal walls and ENS networks. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses robust primary antibodies (HuC/D and PGP9.5) conjugated to compatible Alexa Fluor dyes (488 and 647), which are explicitly validated for iDISCO+. Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568 provides high-contrast F-actin labeling of smooth muscle layers (circular/longitudinal) and submucosal structure without interfering with neural signals. This combination enables simultaneous visualization of mucosal-submucosal-muscular layering and both myenteric and submucosal plexuses in their native spatial context.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for colon pigment removal)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-HuC/D (1:500) and anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody + Phalloidin Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:100) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount colon in a custom glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate prior to imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D + Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The problem requires deep, uniform immunolabeling of both neuronal somata (myenteric and submucosal ganglia) and pan-neuronal fibers across an intact 6–8 cm mouse colon, with minimal background in muscular layers and preserved wall stratification. iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for long tubular organs (T06 tier), offering strong delipidation, high refractive index matching, and excellent antibody penetration—critical for thick, dense gut tissue. It effectively reduces autofluorescence and muscle background while preserving 3D architecture. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so we use validated target-specific primary antibodies: Hu C/D labels neuronal nuclei/somata in both myenteric and submucosal plexuses, while PGP9.5 (a pan-neuronal ubiquitin hydrolase) robustly stains all ENS fibers. These are paired with Alexa Fluor 488 and 647, respectively—fluorophores confirmed compatible with iDISCO+. This dual-labeling strategy enables clear distinction of ganglia (Hu C/D+) from dense fiber networks (PGP9.5+), facilitates layer-specific localization, and supports quantitative 3D topology analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for gut autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Hu C/D (e.g., Invitrogen A-21271, 1:500) and anti-PGP9.5 (e.g., Abcam ab81856, 1:400) diluted in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-Labeling Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount in glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 647, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D visualization of podocyte slit diaphragm structures across the entire mouse kidney, which demands deep antibody penetration and strong lipid/pigment removal due to the tissue’s density and heterogeneous composition (cortex vs. medulla). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for whole mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering rapid, high-clearing power with excellent compatibility for Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 conjugates—both critical for dual-labeling Nephrin and Podocin, which are core structural components of the slit diaphragm. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so direct immunolabeling with bright, photostable Alexa dyes is optimal. This strategy avoids non-specific markers (e.g., CD31) and ensures target-specific, high-fidelity labeling of the filtration barrier.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if pigmentation present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) and anti-Podocin (NPHS2), each diluted 1:200 in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (for Nephrin) and donkey anti-goat IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (for Podocin), each diluted 1:500 in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle shaking)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity, deep-penetrating immunolabeling of two transmembrane slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin and Podocin) in an intact, fixed mouse kidney (~1 cm scale), which is a dense, lipid-rich soft organ. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for this tissue tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering strong delipidation, excellent antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488/568—both explicitly marked as compatible with iDISCO+. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are not used; instead, target-specific primary antibodies against Nephrin and Podocin paired with robust synthetic fluorophores ensure specific, stable labeling of the slit diaphragm architecture. Although iDISCO+ induces moderate tissue shrinkage, it preserves overall renal morphology sufficiently for spatial mapping of glomerular distribution and volume analysis. Organic solvents enable rapid, uniform clearing across the entire kidney, critical for whole-organ 3D quantification.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:200) and anti-Podocin (NPHS2) goat polyclonal antibody (1:200) in PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washes Post Primary  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) in PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Washes Post Secondary  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash, protected from light)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in airtight glass vial wrapped in aluminum foil at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Myosin VIIa–Alexa Fluor 568, TO-PRO-3]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-clearing-power method established for hard tissues like the bony cochlea (T07_HARD_TISSUE_BONE_TOOTH_COCHLEA), enabling deep penetration of dyes/antibodies while effectively clearing mineralized and lipid-rich structures. It preserves Alexa Fluor dye signals robustly and is compatible with Phalloidin (for F-actin/sterocilia) and Myosin VIIa (a specific marker for cochlear hair cells). TO-PRO-3 provides nuclear counterstain without interfering with hair cell identity markers. Although FDISCO quenches endogenous FPs, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous dyes/antibodies. The method balances speed, clearing efficacy, and structural preservation critical for comparing basal/middle/apical turns.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation and Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS) + 0.5% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Myosin VIIa (e.g., Proteus Biosciences #25-6790, 1:200) in PBST + 5% NGS + 0.5% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Co-staining  
7.1 Incubation with Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100) + anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) + TO-PRO-3 (1:1000) in PBST + 5% NGS + 0.5% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 four times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

10 Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, Sigma D8290).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Imaging Preparation  
11.1 Transfer sample to glass-bottom imaging dish filled with fresh DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor 488, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The sample is a mineralized, dense hard tissue (intact mouse cochlea with bone), requiring a high-clearing-power method that enables deep antibody and dye penetration while preserving fine 3D morphology of hair cells, stereocilia bundles, and neural processes. FDISCO—a solvent-based, fluorescence-preserving variant of DISCO—is established for hard tissues like cochlea and bone, provides strong delipidation and refractive index homogenization, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes. Myosin VIIa specifically labels cochlear hair cells, Phalloidin robustly stains F-actin in stereocilia bundles, and PGP9.5 (a pan-neuronal marker) reliably visualizes cochlear nerve fibers, enabling precise mapping of innervation patterns relative to hair cell architecture. All three labels are antibody/dye-based (not endogenous FPs), which aligns with FDISCO’s compatibility profile.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment removal in cochlea)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Myosin VIIa (1:200), anti-PGP9.5 (1:200) in PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:300), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:300), and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation and Clearing  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with benzyl ether (BE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh benzyl ether (BE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with benzyl ether (BE) and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488 (optional for neural analysis)]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-clearing-power method specifically validated for dense mineralized tissues like the bony cochlea (T07_HARD_TISSUE_BONE_TOOTH_COCHLEA). It enables deep penetration of antibodies and dyes into intact cochlear bone while achieving strong transparency—addressing the user’s prior failure with BoneClear-R. Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, Ce3D), FDISCO efficiently removes lipids and decalcifies mildly during dehydration, critical for bone-rich cochleae. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, the user’s targets (Myosin VIIa for hair cell identity; Phalloidin for F-actin/sterocilia bundles) are best labeled via direct immunostaining or conjugated dyes, which FDISCO preserves robustly. Alexa Fluor 488/568/647 are all compatible with FDISCO and provide spectrally distinct, photostable signals for multiplexed 3D imaging of inner/outer hair cells, stereocilia integrity, and optional neural fibers (via PGP9.5). The protocol integrates labeling before delipidation to maximize antibody/dye penetration, followed by graded dehydration and refractive index matching in DBE for low-background, low-distortion light-sheet/confocal imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling and Phalloidin Staining  
1.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Myosin VIIa (1:200) and optional anti-PGP9.5 (1:300), plus Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in blocking buffer (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  
1.3 Wash with PBST (0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total, changed every 2 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (if Myosin VIIa host is rabbit) and/or Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse (if PGP9.5 host is mouse), 1:300 in blocking buffer (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours with gentle shaking)  
1.5 Wash with PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total, changed every 2 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Delipidation and Decalcification Enhancement  
3.1 Incubation with 1:2 mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with 1:1 mixture of DCM and dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% DBE (Sigma, 108014-1KG) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh 100% DBE and seal (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 1 week)  
5.2 Mount in DBE-compatible imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFAP + Alexa Fluor 568, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D visualization of glial scar boundaries and assessment of axonal regeneration across the scar in a large (~40 mm), dense CNS tissue. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for long spinal cord segments (T06 tier), offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so we use immunolabeling: GFAP is the canonical marker for reactive astrocytes defining the glial scar; β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all axons, enabling evaluation of whether regenerating fibers penetrate the scar. Both Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 are highly compatible with iDISCO+ and provide stable, bright signals suitable for light-sheet imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-GFAP (1:500) and anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit (matching GFAP host) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit (matching TUJ1 host), each at 1:500 in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle agitation)

8.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFAP + Alexa Fluor 647, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D discrimination of reactive vs. quiescent astrocytes and analysis of axonal trajectories relative to the glial scar in a large (40 mm), dense CNS tissue segment. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for long spinal cord segments (T06 tier), offering strong delipidation power, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so we use immunolabeling: GFAP is the canonical marker for astrocyte reactivity (upregulated in scar-forming astrocytes), enabling spatial mapping of scar boundaries; β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all axons, allowing assessment of regeneration or barrier effects at the scar interface. Alexa Fluor 647 and 488 are both compatible with iDISCO+ and provide spectrally separable, photostable signals for dual-channel 3D imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Storage  
1.1 Post-fixation in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS overnight.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)  
1.2 Wash in PBS three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
1.3 Store in PBS with 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide at 4 ℃ until processing.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 1 week)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord pigmentation)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Permeabilization and Blocking  
5.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Primary Antibody Incubation  
6.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in blocking solution: anti-GFAP (1:500) and anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) (1:1000).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle agitation)  

7 Washing  
7.1 Wash with PBT six times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash, total 3 days)  

8 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
8.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in blocking solution: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle agitation)  

9 Post-Labeling Washes  
9.1 Wash with PBT six times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash, total 3 days)  

10 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for equilibration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
12.2 Transfer to 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Mount cleared spinal cord segment vertically in a glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in sealed container)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFAP + Alexa Fluor 647, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is a high-clearing-power solvent-based method established for long, dense CNS tissues (e.g., 40 mm spinal cord), enabling deep antibody penetration and whole-organ transparency with minimal light scattering. It preserves Alexa Fluor 488/647 signals robustly—critical for dual-channel imaging of GFAP⁺ astroglial scar boundaries and β-III tubulin⁺ axonal fibers. Endogenous FPs are quenched in uDISCO, so primary antibodies conjugated to compatible synthetic fluorophores (Alexa Fluor series) are used instead. This combination allows precise 3D mapping of axon–scar spatial relationships, including penetration, bypass, or arrest at the lesion border, fulfilling the quantitative morphometric goals.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Storage  
1.1 Post-fixation in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS (pH 7.4) overnight.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
1.3 Store in PBS with 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide at 4 ℃ until processing.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 1 week)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Bleaching (optional for endogenous pigment removal)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Permeabilization and Blocking  
5.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Primary Antibody Incubation  
6.1 Incubation with anti-GFAP (mouse or rabbit monoclonal, 1:500) and anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, mouse or rabbit monoclonal, 1:500) diluted in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle agitation)  

7 Washing  
7.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 six times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours per wash, total 36 hours)  

8 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
8.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-host-IgG (for GFAP) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-host-IgG (for TUJ1), each at 1:500 dilution in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) NDS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle agitation)  

9 Post-labeling Washing  
9.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 six times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours per wash, total 36 hours)  

10 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Repeat incubation with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG) without shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Transfer to fresh DBE in a glass imaging chamber.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥30 minutes before imaging)  

13 Imaging and Storage  
13.1 Image immediately using light-sheet or confocal microscopy (RI of DBE ≈ 1.56).  
13.2 For short-term storage, keep sample submerged in DBE at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: up to 1 week)

我需要对大鼠完整脊髓损伤样本进行透明化处理，用于观察损伤区域胶质瘢痕和星形胶质细胞反应。样本为大鼠完整脊髓，约 40 mm × 4 mm × 3 mm，包含损伤部位和上下各约 1 cm 正常组织，已完成固定和后固定。科学目标是在脊髓损伤区域同时标记反应性星形胶质细胞形成的胶质瘢痕和邻近星形胶质细胞群体；若需要判断再生轴突是否穿过瘢痕，则应在胶质瘢痕标记之外加入轴突/再生轴突信号。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFAP + Alexa Fluor 488, S100β + Alexa Fluor 568, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The user’s prior use of uDISCO caused severe shrinkage and signal loss in long spinal cord segments. iDISCO+ offers superior antibody penetration and reduced tissue distortion compared to uDISCO for dense CNS tissues like spinal cord, while maintaining strong delipidation and clearing power for samples >30 mm. It is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes (488/568/647), which are photostable and resistant to organic solvent quenching. GFAP and S100β together robustly label reactive astrocytes and glial scar boundaries; replacing one channel with β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) enables assessment of axonal regeneration through the scar. All chosen markers are target-specific for astrocytes (GFAP, S100β) and pan-neuronal/axonal structures (β-III Tubulin), fulfilling the scientific goals without relying on endogenous FPs or nuclear counterstains.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigment present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-GFAP (e.g., rabbit monoclonal, 1:500), anti-S100β (e.g., mouse monoclonal, 1:500), and anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, e.g., chicken polyclonal, 1:1000) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500), and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-chicken IgG (1:500) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-Labeling Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE and seal tightly.(Temperature: RT, protected from light, store until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-ChAT + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-TH + Alexa Fluor 568, cTnT (肌钙蛋白) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The sample is a dense, pigmented (~10 mm) fixed mouse heart requiring deep antibody penetration and strong delipidation to overcome myoglobin/blood-derived background and achieve uniform transparency. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based method for this tissue tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering high clearing power, rapid processing, and excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so target-specific immunolabeling is essential: ChAT (choline acetyltransferase) marks cholinergic intrinsic cardiac neurons/ganglia; TH (tyrosine hydroxylase) labels noradrenergic sympathetic fibers; cTnT provides cardiomyocyte structural reference without substituting neural identity. 8.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Stabilin-2 + Alexa Fluor 488, Lyve-1 + Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a rapid solvent-based clearing method compatible with thick (≤3 mm) tissue slices, providing strong delipidation and high refractive index matching within ~24 hours. It preserves Alexa Fluor dyes effectively and supports deep antibody penetration—critical for labeling liver sinusoidal endothelial cells (LSECs). Stabilin-2 and Lyve-1 are highly specific LSEC markers, while CD31 serves as a pan-endothelial marker to delineate portal tracts and larger vessels. All three primary antibodies can be conjugated to Alexa Fluor dyes (488/568/647), which are fully compatible with FDISCO per the knowledge base. This combination enables multiplexed visualization of LSEC subtypes against the broader vascular scaffold within the required timeframe.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Blocking with 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS) in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Stabilin-2 (1:200), anti-Lyve-1 (1:200), anti-CD31 (1:200) in PBST with 5% NGS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)  
2.3 Wash with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488–, Alexa Fluor 568–, and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated (all 1:500) in PBST with 5% NGS.(Temperature: RT, protected from light, Time: 8 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation and Bleaching  
4.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, protected from light, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Wash with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Transfer sample to fresh ECi in a glass imaging chamber.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥30 minutes before imaging)  
6.2 Seal chamber and proceed to confocal microscopy within 24 hours post-fixation.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-ChAT + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-TH + Alexa Fluor 568, phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for visualizing sparse cardiac intrinsic neurons and sympathetic fibers throughout the intact heart. It preserves morphology with acceptable shrinkage and is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes conjugated to primary/secondary antibodies. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in iDISCO+, so target-specific immunolabeling is required. ChAT (choline acetyltransferase) and TH (tyrosine hydroxylase) are definitive markers for cholinergic and noradrenergic innervation, respectively. Phalloidin labels F-actin in cardiomyocytes, providing structural context for regional nerve distribution without interfering with neural identity. All chosen fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488/568/647) are explicitly compatible with iDISCO+ per the knowledge base.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-ChAT (e.g., goat anti-ChAT, 1:200) + anti-TH (e.g., rabbit anti-TH, 1:500) diluted in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washes Post Primary  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody + Phalloidin Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-goat IgG–Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) + donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) + phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200) in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Washes Post Secondary  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-ChAT + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-TH + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense, lipid- and pigment-rich mouse soft organs (T05 tier) like the heart. It provides strong delipidation, effective hemoglobin/myoglobin decolorization via methanol/H₂O₂ treatment, deep antibody penetration, and high refractive index matching—critical for reducing red background and enabling 3D imaging of intrinsic cardiac neurons. Unlike CUBIC-RA alone, iDISCO+ includes essential pre-clearing steps (dehydration, bleaching, delipidation) that address the user’s prior issues of residual turbidity and weak signal. Alexa Fluor 488 and 568 are compatible with iDISCO+, offering bright, photostable signals for ChAT (cholinergic neurons/ganglia) and TH (sympathetic fibers), respectively, without relying on endogenous fluorescence. This strategy preserves morphology sufficiently for ICN topological analysis while minimizing background.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (Hemoglobin/Myoglobin Removal)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for Antibody Labeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-ChAT (e.g., goat anti-ChAT, 1:200) and anti-TH (e.g., rabbit anti-TH, 1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 changes every 4 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:300) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-Labeling Washing  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 changes every 4 hours)  

9 Dehydration (Post-Labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount in glass-bottom dish or capillary filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-ChAT + Alexa Fluor 568, anti-TH + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense, lipid-rich mouse organs like the heart (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM tier). It provides strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration required for whole-heart immunolabeling of ChAT (cholinergic ICN neurons) and TH (noradrenergic sympathetic fibers), while enabling high-resolution 3D imaging of fine neural processes. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses robust, covalently conjugated Alexa Fluor dyes—specifically Alexa Fluor 488 (Phalloidin for F-actin/myofiber orientation), Alexa Fluor 568 (anti-ChAT), and Alexa Fluor 647 (anti-TH)—all confirmed compatible with iDISCO+. DAPI is included cautiously as a nuclear counterstain to aid anatomical registration, with minimized exposure during dehydration to preserve signal. This combination allows simultaneous mapping of ICN ganglia (ChAT+), sympathetic innervation (TH+), myocardial architecture (Phalloidin+), and cellular context (DAPI+) in a single cleared heart.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for cardiac pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 5% (wt/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-ChAT (e.g., goat anti-ChAT, 1:200) and anti-TH (e.g., rabbit anti-TH, 1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washes Post Primary  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Co-staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300), and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in PBT + 5% NDS + 0.2% sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light)  

8 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)  
8.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  

9 Final Washes  
9.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Mount cleared heart in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE, oriented for optimal visualization of atria and epicardium.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD8 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense, lipid-rich FFPE-derived thick sections (≤500 μm), offering strong delipidation and high refractive index matching for deep imaging while preserving antibody-based fluorescence. It is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and 568 conjugates, which are ideal for distinguishing pan-T cells (CD3) and cytotoxic T cell subset (CD8). Unlike endogenous FP-dependent methods, FDISCO avoids reliance on genetically encoded reporters—critical for human clinical FFPE samples—and provides rapid, high-fidelity clearing with minimal loss of epitope integrity when combined with post-rehydration immunostaining.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining (post-dehydration rehydration and labeling)  
2.1 Rehydrate through descending methanol series: 70%, 50%, 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)  
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD3 (1:200) and anti-CD8 (1:200) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.4 Wash with PBST (0.1% Tween-20 in PBS), 6 changes over 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:400) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.6 Wash thoroughly with PBST, 6 changes over 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  

3 Dehydration (post-staining)  
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation and Bleaching  
4.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh from 30% H₂O₂ stock).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma 112372-500G-F).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mount sample in fresh ethyl cinnamate in a glass-bottom imaging chamber compatible with high-RI immersion objectives.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Ki67 (MKI67)+Alexa Fluor 488, PCNA+Alexa Fluor 568, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** The sample is a small (~300 μm), fixed human intestinal organoid requiring preservation of 3D architecture and rapid processing within 1–2 days. MACS is an aqueous-based clearing method established for T03_SMALL_WHOLE_SAMPLE_1_5MM, offering excellent morphology preservation, compatibility with both Alexa Fluor dyes and nuclear counterstains (Hoechst), and efficient antibody penetration without organic solvents that cause shrinkage. Ki67 and PCNA are canonical, target-specific markers for proliferating cells (nuclear localization), and dual immunolabeling with spectrally distinct Alexa Fluor conjugates enables robust 3D mapping of cell cycle activity. Hoechst provides contextual nuclear labeling without interfering with the primary targets and is fully compatible with MACS.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunostaining (post-fixation)  
1.1 Wash in PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)  
1.2 Permeabilization and blocking: Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.3 Primary antibody incubation: Anti-Ki67 (1:200) and anti-PCNA (1:200) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.4 Wash thoroughly in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  
1.5 Secondary antibody incubation: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)  
1.6 Wash in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 × 1 hour)  
1.7 Nuclear counterstain: Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.8 Final wash in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)  

2 Tissue Optical Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with MACS-R0 (20 vol% MXDA, 15% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.40). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with MACS-R1 (40 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.48). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.51). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3.1 Transfer organoid into fresh MACS-R2 for final RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥30 minutes before imaging)  
3.2 Mount in glass-bottom imaging dish or capillary filled with MACS-R2 for light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

NeuN (RBFOX3) and MAP2 are well-validated pan-mature neuronal markers—NeuN labels neuronal nuclei and perikarya, while MAP2 specifically labels dendritic and somatic cytoskeleton—providing complementary structural information on mature neurons without relying on endogenous fluorescent proteins or nuclear counterstains that lack target specificity.

1.4 Incubation with PBS only (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-NeuN (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) and anti-MAP2 (rabbit polyclonal, 1:500) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in PBS) (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle agitation)

4.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 buffer changes at 2-hour intervals)

6 Post-staining Washes  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 buffer changes at 2-hour intervals, protected from light)
